name: commit-graph-write-verify
setup:
git init -q -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do printf '%s\n' "$i" > f$i && git add f$i && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" git commit -q -m "c$i"; done &&
git checkout -q -b topic HEAD~3 &&
printf 't\n' > tf && git add tf && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912100 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912100 +0000' git commit -q -m ct &&
git checkout -q main && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912200 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912200 +0000' git merge -q --no-ff -m merge topic
git commit-graph write --reachable

name: commit-graph-generation-consistency
setup:
git init -q -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do printf '%s\n' "$i" > f$i && git add f$i && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" git commit -q -m "c$i"; done &&
git checkout -q -b topic HEAD~3 &&
printf 't\n' > tf && git add tf && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912100 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912100 +0000' git commit -q -m ct &&
git checkout -q main && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912200 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912200 +0000' git merge -q --no-ff -m merge topic
git rev-list --count --all > /tmp/before-count &&
git merge-base main topic > /tmp/before-mb &&
git commit-graph write --reachable
probes: git merge-base main topic > /tmp/after-mb && diff /tmp/before-mb /tmp/after-mb && echo MB-SAME

name: commit-graph-advisory
setup:
git init -q -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do printf '%s\n' "$i" > f$i && git add f$i && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" git commit -q -m "c$i"; done &&
git checkout -q -b topic HEAD~3 &&
printf 't\n' > tf && git add tf && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912100 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912100 +0000' git commit -q -m ct &&
git checkout -q main && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912200 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912200 +0000' git merge -q --no-ff -m merge topic
git commit-graph write --reachable &&
git log --oneline --format='%H %s' | sort > /tmp/with-graph
probes: rm -f .git/objects/info/commit-graph && git log --oneline --format='%H %s' | sort > /tmp/no-graph && diff /tmp/with-graph /tmp/no-graph && echo ADVISORY-OK

name: midx-write-verify
setup:
git init -q -b main . &&
printf 'a\n' > a && git add a && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m c1 && git repack -q -a -d &&
printf 'b\n' > b && git add b && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912000 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912000 +0000' git commit -q -m c2 && git repack -q -d &&
printf 'c\n' > c && git add c && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912100 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912100 +0000' git commit -q -m c3 && git repack -q -d &&
git multi-pack-index write
probes: git rev-list --count --objects --all | awk '{print $1}' | tail -1; git rev-list --count --all
git fsck --strict 2>&1 | grep -v '^Checking' | tail -1; echo fsck-done

name: midx-advisory
setup:
git init -q -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3; do printf '%s\n' "$i" > f$i && git add f$i && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="@$((1112911993+i)) +0000" git commit -q -m c$i && git repack -q -d; done &&
git rev-list --objects --all | sort > /tmp/nomidx &&
git multi-pack-index write
probes: git rev-list --objects --all | sort > /tmp/withmidx && diff /tmp/nomidx /tmp/withmidx && echo MIDX-ADVISORY-OK

setup:

name: midx-bitmap
setup:
git init -q -b main . &&

git multi-pack-index write --bitmap
